# sigma_file (Resource)

Manages an empty Sigma workspace, folder, workbook, or report through the files API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sigma_file" "example" {
  type        = "folder"
  name        = "Terraform Managed"
  parent_id   = sigma_workspace.example.id
  description = "Managed by Terraform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) File name.
- `type` (String) Creatable file type: `workspace`, `folder`, `workbook`, or `report`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) File description.
- `owner_id` (String) Member ID of the file owner.
- `parent_id` (String) Parent folder ID.

### Read-Only

- `badge` (String) Badge applied to the file.
- `created_at` (String) File creation timestamp.
- `created_by` (String) ID of the member who created the file.
- `id` (String) Inode ID.
- `is_archived` (Boolean) Whether the file is archived.
- `parent_source_url_id` (String) Source document URL ID for a tenant deployment.
- `parent_url_id` (String) Parent identifier used in Sigma URLs.
- `path` (String) File path.
- `permission` (String) Effective permission.
- `updated_at` (String) File update timestamp.
- `updated_by` (String) ID of the member who last updated the file.
- `url_id` (String) Identifier used in Sigma URLs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sigma_file.example inode-id
```
